title: Install and recover verified ordinary Windows launches and prepare a successor on accepted source
goal: The native qualifier admits, exports and deploys the exact Windows release. Fresh users launch through PATH and Start Menu without project tools; the SHA-bound selector preserves a running image, recovers interruption, rejects tamper and supports a verified rollback. Prepare the next patch only on a clean, receipted descendant of the promoted release, preserving unrelated governance, manifests and locked dependencies. Reject legacy production commands before state access. Combined source acceptance includes the startup hook f44405a84, producer bridge 5a2f846d6, and the original locked dependency graph. The original UTF-16 Shell Link writer and its one reviewed Windows environment broadcast add no external dependency.
